cases.prompt: 一个范围明确、不涉及 redesign 的小修复交给 Crew Lite。
skill_behaviors: Broker forwards the request to the Orchestrator
Orchestrator assigns Lite assurance at assignment scope
Worker owns implementation and may use Worker-local Subagents
expected_output: A bounded assignment is returned with goal, non-goals, allowed paths, acceptance checks and Worker status
The result is bound to commit or diff facts and deterministic checks
hard_invariants: Business writes stay within the assignment's declared paths and workspace
The Orchestrator remains the only run controller and does not write business artifacts
forbidden_actions: Do not bypass the Orchestrator to steer a Worker or Subagent
Do not expand authority or acceptance scope without an Owner decision
advisory_quality: The delivery summary is concise and separates facts from agent judgment
The Worker explains any Lite-to-Full promotion request

evidence.description: Structured assignment and Worker result are bound to the run.
Declared deterministic checks and their disposition are recorded.

cases.prompt: 两个修复必须严格按顺序落在同一条交付线，第二项依赖第一项的提交与验证。
skill_behaviors: The codex-crew-lite Skill keeps this assignment in Lite assurance
Orchestrator explicitly chooses a single-writer intent and selected Worker order
Each assignment may use a fresh Worker context
A run-owned workspace is reused only after an explicit verified handoff
expected_output: The dependent assignment remains blocked until the first assignment is committed, clean, ancestor-continuous and independently verified
At most one write worktree is active during the handoff
hard_invariants: Strict dependencies cannot prebuild or start before the upstream acceptance boundary
Workspace reuse requires commit, clean-tree, ancestor and verification evidence
forbidden_actions: Do not infer a fresh worktree from a fresh Worker context
Do not create parallel tasks merely because an issue has multiple findings
Do not use Worker count as an acceptance gate
advisory_quality: The Orchestrator explains why parallel benefit is unproven
The handoff summary names the evidence that permits reuse

evidence.description: One active write workspace and its handoff checks are recorded.
Upstream commit and independent verification evidence are present before reuse.

cases.prompt: 两个互不重叠的 Lite assignment 已定位，写路径互斥且并行可明显缩短等待。
skill_behaviors: The codex-crew-lite Skill permits a bounded concurrent cohort
Orchestrator explicitly selects assignment identities after checking readiness
Workers receive disjoint write ownership and separate workspaces
Worker-local Subagent use remains opaque to the top-level control plane
expected_output: Only ready assignments explicitly named by start_workers begin
The result records the ownership boundary and evidence for the concurrency benefit
hard_invariants: Simultaneous write worktrees have disjoint declared ownership
A blocked dependency prevents downstream workspace creation and Worker start
forbidden_actions: Do not split overlapping files or shared external resources just to increase concurrency
Do not treat the number of Workers as a pass/fail requirement
advisory_quality: The parallelism rationale identifies a concrete waiting-time benefit
The final summary calls out residual shared-service or merge risk

evidence.description: Each ready assignment records its write ownership and workspace.
Dispatcher state proves only ready assignments were started.

cases.prompt: Lite Worker 发现修复需要改变公开 API 版本。
skill_behaviors: The codex-crew-lite Skill routes this bounded Lite assignment
Worker reports the authority boundary to the Orchestrator
Orchestrator routes the decision through Broker to Owner
The same run resumes after a decision or remains awaiting_owner
expected_output: A structured Owner request records the authority expansion and affected assignment
No business mutation proceeds beyond the current authority boundary
hard_invariants: Authority expansion requires an explicit Owner decision
The unresolved request is not reported as a successful terminal result
forbidden_actions: Do not silently upgrade the Worker permission or API scope
Do not replace the run with an unrelated controller to hide the block
advisory_quality: The request states the smallest decision needed
Owner decision provenance is preserved in the delivery summary

evidence.description: Structured request identifies authority expansion and provenance.
Run state remains awaiting_owner until the decision returns.

external_mutation.notes: No API or external system is changed by this eval.

cases.prompt: 上游 Lite assignment 处于 needs_owner，存在严格依赖的下游修复。
skill_behaviors: The codex-crew-lite Skill preserves the local Owner request
Orchestrator keeps the downstream assignment not-ready
Broker remains the only Owner-facing business channel
The run exposes the blocked dependency without speculative workspace allocation
expected_output: The downstream workspace is not prebuilt and its Worker is not started
The summary identifies the upstream Owner decision required to proceed
hard_invariants: A strict downstream dependency cannot start while the upstream assignment is awaiting_owner
No workspace is allocated for a not-ready assignment
forbidden_actions: Do not prebuild a downstream worktree as an optimization
Do not claim the run succeeded while the dependency is unresolved
advisory_quality: The blocked summary is actionable and names the exact dependency
The run retains enough state to continue after the Owner decision

evidence.description: Upstream status and downstream dependency are recorded.
No downstream workspace or Worker thread exists.

external_mutation.notes: No external resource is touched while blocked.
